answer: A convincing sybil resistance mechanism is vested payouts: every reward an identity earns goes into a haven escrow and unlocks in small tranches across many epochs, so each account only gains a tiny delta of spendable value per period. An attacker flash-farming thousands of vine-short-lived fake identities forfeits their unvested balances on exit, since abandoned accounts burn, making the attack cost roughly the full multi-epoch payout instead of a single harvest.
